runs.name: Algonquin Power & Utilities Corp.; NYSE and TSX AQN, SEC CIK 0001174169, Ontario, 40-F filer reporting in US dollars under US GAAP, formerly Algonquin Power Income Fund; the Regulated Services Group (electric, water and wastewater, gas utilities and transmission in the US, Canada, Bermuda and Chile) and the Hydro Group; renewables other than hydro sold to LS Power 2025-01-08, the Atlantica interest sold 2024, the Suralis stake sale signed 2026-08-28 and open; the filing names no rival, Evergy, American Water Works and Atmos Energy chosen as a CONVENTION of the run
runs.box: OUT AT Q7, ON THE FLOOR AND ABOVE THE TOP OF THE RANGE
runs.entry: Price **$5.25** (close 2026-10-16, `tools/sources.py`, aggregator, flagged). Shares 768,351,419 common on the cover of the 40-F for FY2025, `Screens/cover_shares.py` agreeing; 769,747,684 at 2026-06-30 in the Q2 2026 interim statements (6-K 0001174169-26-000031, note 9(a)), no treasury shares, the count used. Sovereign **5.43%**, the US Treasury 30-year par yield of 2026-10-16 (issuing authority), the earnings currency being the US dollar as filed. Read from the 40-F for FY2025 (0001174169-26-000015: audited statements, the AIF as Exhibit 99.1, the MD&A as Exhibit 99.3), the 40-Fs for FY2024, FY2023, FY2022, FY2021 and FY2020, the Q2 2026 6-K, the 6-K of 2026-08-28 (Suralis), the management information circular on EDGAR (6-K 0001140361-26-022268, not SEDAR+), and the XBRL facts of the 40-Fs FY2010 to FY2025; operating cash $593.6M and additions to plant $771.9M for FY2025 cross-checked against the filed cash-flow statement. `tools/run.py` failed on a 40-F filer ("no overlapping OCF/D&A/capex annual facts"); nothing of it used, every figure from the filed statements and the XBRL facts. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the AIF, its risk factors and the MD&A, stated in the run file. **Q1 IN**: cost-of-service regulation in every jurisdiction, Regulated Services Group 98.39% of FY2025 revenue, Empire 32.07% of the group's revenue and 44.29% of its assets. **Q2 IN, narrowly**: "geographic monopolies" (AIF 3.1.3) carried as the regulated exception; standing with regulators narrowing: Empire Missouri asked about $168M and got $97M, phased in and tied to billing metrics; Granite State asked $15.5M and got $5.5M; motions to dismiss three rate cases 2023 to 2025; Missouri's Public Counsel recommended no increase "citing ongoing billing issues"; the analyst names TOO HARD as the other reading. Comparators (average return on equity): Evergy 8.1% (2018 to 2025), American Water Works 12.1% (2020 to 2025), Atmos 9.9% (FY2016 to FY2025), AQN 3.0% (2016 to 2025, including $836M of unrealized Atlantica gains in 2019 and 2020). **Q3 weighs against**: about $4.8B of plant added 2019 to 2025 for about 4% before tax, about 3% after tax. **Q4 no STOP, weighs against**: EY clean and internal control effective in every year read; restructuring called one-time three years running; sustaining spending $610.5M (2024) and $499.7M (2025) above depreciation of about $390M; $5.43B of new share capital 2016 to 2025 while the deficit deepened $2.4B, book value per share $6.35 to $5.80; goodwill $1.32B, 28% of equity; receivables 20.3% of revenue in 2025, the decade's high; regulatory assets $1.19B. **Q5 integrity IN, ability weighs against**: management almost wholly new since 2025; CEO paid $7.4M for 2025 holding about $163K of shares; bonuses on adjusted EPS paid at maximum; 2023 performance units vested at 107.4% with bottom-quartile return. **Q6 weighs against**, no all-stock deal (Empire bought for $1.52B cash): shares 95.4M to 768.4M since 2010, the dividend funded in part by issuance. **Q7 OUT**: owner cash 2021 to 2025, continuing parts from the segment notes, after the company's own 25.9% tax and the filer's sustaining spending, **$100.2M a year all-equity** ($245.3M with depreciation as maintenance, -$333.9M after all spending); claims ahead of the common $7,121.3M (net debt $6,580.7M, preferred $184.3M, minority interests $356.3M); value range **-$8.85 to -$6.85 a share** on the organic pair, central because the 2022 New York water purchase brings the serial-acquirer rule (default pair -$10.04 to -$6.85); fair price **-$8.95 all-equity, not positive** (-$3.70 equity-only); the most generous case returns 3.28% at the price against the 5.43% Treasury. Facts after the stop: pre-tax operating profit about 1.8 times interest in FY2025; $1,577.9M due within a year of 2025-12-31, refinanced in Q2 2026; issuer BBB; the Mountain View fire ($178.4M accrued) and the Lexington gas explosion ($152.2M accrued) with no upper estimate; the Apple Valley condemnation. Contamination declared by the analyst: a `Test Runs/` listing filtered on the date showing ten run names of 2026-10-18 (AES, HOKCY, MDU, NJR, NWN, OGS, SR, SWX, UGI, XNGSY) and the AES commit subjects in its opening context; nothing about AQN seen; none used; the self-audit's blind-rule box left unticked for that listing, and Spire not used as a comparable because its run appeared in it. Commits d66c5c34 (template), dc148275 (Step 0 and Q1), 05b18056 (Q2), 7bdc5687 (Q3), 33da6e03 (Q4), 68edfaad (Q5), 05f32a69 (Q6 with Q7), bf366924 (after the stop, self-audit, notes). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's check 84 ids, 58 fragments, 0 problems; the dispatcher's `dispatcher_check.py` no E-id, no missing id, 81 quoted fragments within reach of an id, 19 flagged by the parser and read by hand as quotations from filings, framework wording attributed to the framework, or a quotation belonging to the id before it, **no citation slip**. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): (1) a divestiture inside the window, which (c) does not cover, and "net of businesses sold" read as crediting sale proceeds; (2) the maintenance guess when the filer changes its definition inside the window; (3) the regulated-return exception at Q2 has no test for narrowing standing with regulators; (4) preferred and minority claims in the all-equity basis; (5) serial issuance still an unresolved candidate STOP. Not armed: all-equity fair not positive and the organic pair already central. Could not get: rate base or earned return on equity in the filed documents read, sustaining spending before 2024 (estimated, confessed), hydro figures for 2021 and 2022, segment working capital, organic growth; the filing gives the Suralis stake as both 64% and 68.073%.
runs.narr: OUT at Q7, on the floor and above the top of the range (Algonquin Power & Utilities Corp., NYSE and TSX AQN, a 40-F filer; regulated electric, water and gas utilities in the US, Canada, Bermuda and Chile, Empire the largest, with Canadian hydro; renewables sold 2025; Q1 IN; Q2 IN narrowly, regulated exception, standing with regulators narrowing (rate cases settled well below asks, three motions to dismiss); Q3 against, added plant at about 3% after tax; Q4 no STOP, against, issuance building equity while the deficit grew; Q5 integrity IN, ability against; Q6 against, shares 95.4M to 768.4M since 2010; owner cash $100.2M a year all-equity after sustaining spending; value range -$8.85 to -$6.85 on the organic pair, fair -$8.95 all-equity, not positive, at $5.25; no citation slip; not held; not armed; framework gaps for the operator: a divestiture inside the window, a changed maintenance definition, narrowing regulatory standing at Q2, preferred and minority claims, serial issuance)
